summary: Examples of mask_secrets redacting a token in a concatenated string and using a custom *** placeholder.
questions: How do I mask secrets with asterisks?

answer_card.title: mask_secrets examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
safe_line: "{{ ('token=' ~ api_token) | mask_secrets }}"
safe_line: "{{ some_text | mask_secrets(mask_placeholder='***') }}"
```
